issue: worktree of the recipe branch is 88 commits ahead of the prebuilt main, and had no submodules
fix: git submodule update --init --recursive, then a full Release rebuild in the worktree

issue: rope donor gpt_oss_d_p/tt/rope.py implements YaRN; Llama 3.1 uses llama3 smooth-ramp scaling with no mscale
fix: wrote llama3_inv_freq fresh and pinned it against transformers ROPE_INIT_FUNCTIONS['llama3']

issue: spec v0 rope block cannot express llama3 scaling: it needs low_freq_factor and high_freq_factor, not beta_fast/beta_slow
fix: took the two factors from the vendored config.json and recorded the gap in docs/SPEC_NOTES.md

issue: recipe fixes per-chip cache shape dim1 at literal 1, true only when TP == n_kv_heads; Llama has 8 KV heads at TP=4
fix: allocate_kv_cache takes num_kv_heads_local = n_kv_heads // tp (2 here) and asserts it against the write

why: Llama has no QK-norm (spec attention.features is empty)
dense model: no MoE router to test

issue: multi-chunk block-cyclic cache read-back gave PCC 0.06: row-concatenation is natural order only for a single chunk
fix: added block_cyclic_to_natural using the writer map g(c,lr)=(lr//C)*sp*C + c*C + lr%C

issue: mixing fabric configs or mesh shapes in one pytest process kills fabric bring-up with a misleading ethernet-handshake timeout
fix: run_bringup.sh runs one group per fabric config and mesh shape

why: a 4-chip submesh of this plain-MESH Galaxy cannot train its fabric links; TP-without-SP is not a spec target

issue: gpt_oss MeshConfig has no reduce_scatter, which minimax's 2D vocab-parallel embedding calls to sum per-row lookups across SP
fix: added MeshConfig.reduce_scatter from the minimax donor; both embedding modes then reach PCC 1.0
